name: Stored Action List As Named Subroutine
description: A reusable 'subroutine' implemented purely through datasets: an action array is saved (never executed) into a dataset via setdataset with nodeepprocess:true, then referenced elsewhere as a bare "[datasetName]" string element inside another action array. The engine expands that bracket reference into whatever action list the dataset currently holds. Distinct from action.filldataset loading a 'part' doctype/docno fragment by key from the server (see molecule.reusable-event-fragment) — this variant is purely local/in-page and defined once in whenload.
sourceRefs: examples/purchase-order-fapo-fapi.md (_fapi-whenload-events: calcformula defined; referenced as "[calcformula]" inside field whenchange arrays and inside _fapo-event-1)

dset.description: Name the subroutine will be invoked by, e.g. "calcformula".

actions.description: The action list to store — typically mergedataset calls recomputing derived/summary fields.

usageNote: Always define once in whenload/wheninit before any control references it. Invocation is a bare string, not an exec object — it can appear as the last element of any action array, including inside another stored formula (recursive splicing), e.g. _fapo-event-1 ends with "[calcformula]" after its own mergedatasetarray call. Keep the defining setdataset first in the whenload action list so nothing races the reference.
